as_told.title: AARO as a front for sifting witnesses

plain: AARO, the Pentagon office set up in 2022 to look into reports of unexplained objects, was undermined from inside by CIA and Air Force people, several guests tell Michels. A guest named Matthew Pines says that once the work moved into AARO it was "compromised by the CIA air force guys", naming Sean Kirkpatrick, who led the office. Jeremy Corbell, speaking as a reporter who cites others, goes further: he says "AARO was acting as a counterintelligence against the American public", a trap that harassed whistleblowers, and he names among his sources the former official James Lacatski and the journalist George Knapp. A witness named Michael Herrera, who says he saw a huge craft in Indonesia, says from his own dealings with the office that it was "a front" for "plucking people to figure out what they know and then either trying to shut them up or just publicly dismissed the person". He names another of its officials, Jon Kosloski. If they are right, the office meant to bring the facts out was used to find and silence witnesses. All three speak from their own experience or from what others told them. None of them points to a document.
